Name: Begonia Atelier - Six Decorative Plants
Author: LittleEddo
Description:
[b]Begonia Atelier — Six Decorative Plants[/b]
Bring vibrant foliage and charming planters into your Stardew Valley home! This mod adds six decorative begonia furniture pieces, perfect for a cozy bedroom, living room, or indoor plant corner.
[b]Six Unique Designs[/b]
• Escargot — Blue and pink spiral foliage in a classical David bust planter.
• Red Robin — Striking red and dark foliage in an elegant ivory pedestal vase.
• Maculata — Spotted green leaves and hanging blossoms in a simple cream planter.
• Silver Leaf — Silvery foliage with dark veins in a black polka-dot pot.
• Moonlit Sakura — Soft pink foliage in a warm peach-colored planter.
• Trout Variegata — Pink and green variegated foliage in a charming elephant planter.
[b]Where to Buy[/b]
All six plants are available at Robin’s Carpenter’s Shop for 1,400g each.
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download and extract this mod.[/*]
[*]Place the “[CP] Begonia Atelier Six” folder into your game’s Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
[b]Upgrading from Previous Versions[/b]
This combined edition uses new furniture item IDs. Furniture from previous versions will not convert automatically.
If you have Begonia Atelier or Begonia Duo installed, back up your save and collect any furniture from those versions before removing their folders and installing this edition.
[b]Thank You[/b]
Thank you for downloading, playing, and sharing your feedback. Enjoy decorating your home with begonias!
